label: Global Financial Crisis and RBA Rate Cuts
summary: STW falls steeply (AUD 31.40 in 2009-02); RBA cuts cash rate from 7.25% to 3.00%; falling AUD (0.6454) amplifies AUD Gold surge (AUD 1,461/oz).

label: AUD Parity Caps Local Gold Gains
summary: USD Gold hits crisis highs (USD 1,759/oz) but AUD/USD above 1.05 (1.0691) caps AUD Gold (AUD 1,645/oz); RBA hikes to 4.75% lift deposits.

label: Gold Bear Market and RBA Easing Cycle
summary: USD Gold drops roughly 40% (USD 1,076/oz), cushioned locally by falling AUD (0.7306); RBA easing pulls retail bonus savings rates from 4.50% (2013-04) to 2.60% (2015-12).

label: COVID-19 Shock and Ultra-Low Interest Rates
summary: Sharp STW shock (AUD 47.99) and stimulus rebound; RBA cuts push bonus savings to a 0.25% trough (2021-10, 0.35% July lock); AUD Gold climbs past AUD 2,677/oz.

label: Post-Pandemic Inflation and Rapid RBA Tightening
summary: Fastest RBA tightening cycle in decades lifts bonus savings rates from 0.45% (2022-05) to a 4.90% peak (2023-11) while weighing on equities; resource dividends peak (AUD 1.9401 STW payout Jun 2022).

label: Central-Bank Gold Record and Pullback
summary: Central-bank demand drives AUD Gold past AUD 7,044/oz (2026-02) before cooling to AUD 5,794/oz (2026-07); STW clears AUD 80.

label: STW Shifts to Quarterly Distributions
summary: STW transitions from semi-annual (Jun/Dec) to quarterly (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) distributions, increasing cash-flow frequency.
